items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I was playing trumpet, Snub Mosley was playing trombone and Godley was playing drums.

ctx.x: Alphonso Trent, yeah. He had a good band. He had Snub Mosley, trombone player Snub Mosley. He had a trumpet player, fantastic trumpet player named Chester Clark. He had a good drummer called A. G. Godley. I think you've heard about him.
Yeah, I've heard of him. Peanuts Holland?

items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I opened with them, and Harry Edison-- ... Yeah, he went down. We stopped by Harry's mother

ctx.x: You were going to open up for them?
I opened with them, and Harry Edison--
Harry Edison was in the band?
